If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US</strong></p> <p class="ql-align-justify">In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="ql-align-justify">By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.</p> <p class="ql-align-justify">Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>Service Rates&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="ql-align-justify">Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>Independent Contractor Relationship</strong></p> <p class="ql-align-justify">This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.</p> </div> <div class="pt-7 figma-padding-bottom-32 tw-border-b tw-border-[#E3E6E8]"> <p class="sui-text-b3 sui-text-darkGray-darker ql-editor">&nbsp;</p> <p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>Qualification Process</strong></p> <p class="ql-align-justify">No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity.&nbsp;However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>Basic Requirements</strong></p> <p class="ql-align-justify">• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English</p> <p class="ql-align-justify">• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years</p> <p class="ql-align-justify">• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States</p> <p class="ql-align-justify">• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms</p> <p class="ql-align-justify">• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content</p> <p class="ql-align-justify">• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection</p> <p class="ql-align-justify">• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)</p> <p class="ql-align-justify">• Access to a personal computer</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="ql-align-justify"><strong>Assessment</strong></p> <p class="ql-align-justify">You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role.
